originalFrozenTask.learnerTask: Distinguish parent-protein amount, phosphopeptide signal and occupancy
originalFrozenTask.accuracyGuardrails: Use separate total-protein and phosphopeptide signals and state normalization/occupancy assumptions. An unchanged ratio or increased phosphosignal does not establish site occupancy, kinase causality or activation.
